brief.audience: The Four Barrel Coffee crowd in San Francisco leans toward youthful, culturally‑curious listeners – fans of indie‑pop and Latin‑infused sounds like Alex Anwandter, Buscabulla, Mon Laferte, Monsieur Periné, Tomasa del Real and Princesa Alba. They also gravitate to artisanal treats from boutique brands such as Salt & Straw, Milk Bar and Mr Holmes Bakehouse.

menu.idea: Dulce de leche latte topped with a scoop of Salt & Straw vanilla‑caramel ice cream (float style).
menu.why: Salt & Straw has the highest affinity (id 7C921F60) with Four Barrel patrons, and the caramel‑sweet profile pairs naturally with coffee.

menu.idea: Cold‑brew hibiscus refresher with crumbled Milk Bar “Cornflake” cookie and a splash of orange blossom water.
menu.why: Milk Bar (id 2C650D56) is a top‑ranked brand for this audience; its playful, sweet‑savory cookies complement the tart hibiscus.

menu.idea: Cardamom‑infused flat white served alongside Mr Holmes Bakehouse’s signature “Mochi” pastry.
menu.why: Mr Holmes Bakehouse (id F4B06070) scores high affinity and is known for minimalist, photogenic baked goods that match the café’s aesthetic.
